name: logo-wall-quote
purpose: The customers band: a section title over a framed logo wall of linked client marks with one signed quote in its aside, closed by a call to action. It is a page section — the site places it from a `{ _id: 'logo-wall-quote', props }` entry and binds `props` straight onto it — and it composes `section-module`, `section-title`, `frame-box`, `logo-wall`, `quote` and `button`.
useWhen: To prove adoption with marks and let one customer speak, early on a home or solution page.
avoidWhen: For several quotes in turn → use `client-quotes`.
For marks with photos and stories in a mosaic → use `client-mosaic`.
related: logo-wall` — the wall the marks are laid in, with the quote in its aside.
bestPractices: Eight or nine logos fill the rectangle wall beside the aside.

Set `logoTreatment` per mark: `monochrome` for a mark drawn in one ink that must follow the theme, `invert-light` for a reversed mark that must flip on the light theme, `as-is` for a colour mark; give a `logoLight` file instead when the light theme needs a different drawing.

props.name: title
props.doc: Headline of the band, rendered by the section title as its `h2`; the band renders no header when empty.

props.name: ariaLabel
props.doc: Accessible name of the logo wall.

props.name: logos
props.doc: The client marks, in order; each is `{ name, logo, logoLight?, logoTreatment?, href? }` where `logoTreatment` is `'as-is'`, `'monochrome'` or `'invert-light'`.

props.name: quote
props.doc: The signed quote in the wall's aside; `{ text, name, jobTitle, logo, logoAlt }`. Omitted when absent.

props.name: primaryAction
props.doc: Button under the quote; `{ label, href, trailing?, target? }`. Omitted when absent.

examples.name: Default
